mapper.insert: INSERT INTO video_info_replica (video_id, user_id, video_name, video_cover, interaction) VALUES (#{video.videoId}, #{video.userId}, #{video.videoName}, #{video.videoCover}, #{video.interaction}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE user_id = VALUES(user_id), video_name = VALUES(video_name), video_cover = VALUES(video_cover), interaction = VALUES(interaction)
